names.note: Read out of the Охридски пролог’s third heading for 19. децембар ст. ст., „Свети Бонифатије Милостиви, епископ ферентијски.“ — «Свети» is “saint” and not a rank, and «епископ ферентијски» is the rank with the see, both of which BRIEF-SERBIAN §6 keeps out of a stored form; «Милостиви», the Merciful, is an epithet and not a rank, so it stays. Measured before it was written: no other folder holds this key. THE BARE «Бонифатије» IS WRITTEN IN THIS SAME COMMIT ON `boniface-of-tarsus`, off the same day’s first heading, and these two strings are two keys that do not fold together — which is why the epithet is kept here rather than stripped to the forename.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 19. децембар ст. ст.: «Скончао мирно у Италији у VI веку» — he ended peacefully in Italy in the sixth century. The book gives no year of birth and no year of death, and none is inferred; this is the only source read for him.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.01.2026 (19. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети Бонифатије Милостиви, епископ ферентијски.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, THREE SENTENCES, and the whole of the dossier: that from childhood he was uncommonly merciful, so much so that his mother reproached him for it; that by prayer he received from the Lord a hundredfold; and that he ended peacefully in Italy in the sixth century. WHY A NEW FOLDER AND NOT A ROW ON ANY BONIFACE THE CORPUS HOLDS: the three it keeps are `boniface-of-tarsus`, the martyr beheaded at Tarsus in 290 whom THIS SAME DAY’S FIRST ENTRY carries separately, two headings apart, which is the book itself keeping them as two men; `boniface-apostle-of-germany`, the eighth-century archbishop of Mainz; and `boniface-of-ross`. None is a sixth-century Italian bishop, none is called the Merciful, and none has a mother who reproached him for almsgiving. `types` is `bishop` alone, off «епископ»; «Милостиви» is an epithet and not a rank. `office` is reduced to the bare `Bishop`, which the locale packs carry, and the see Ферентино is in the display-free part of the record and in the life, because a new `office` string costs four translations a reader may not invent. NO `locations`: Italy is a country the entry does not bound and the see is the only place it names. NO `dates` beyond the century it states. NO `related`: the entry names nobody but his mother, who has no folder. The Prologue prints no hymn.
